problem:
Which of the following values ​are possible outputs of $f(x)=-{(2)}^{-x}?$

- $0$
- $0.5$
- $-0.5$
worked_solution:
The range of ${2}^{-x}$ is

$$
{2}^{-x}>0.
$$

Multiplying the above inequality by $-1$ yields the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}(-1){(2)}^{-x} & <0 \\ -{(2)}^{-x} & <0 \\ f(x) & <0\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, the range is $f(x)<0.$ Thus, of the given values, only $y=-0.5$ is an output of $y=f(x).$

We can also see that this is true from the graph of the function. The graph of $y=f(x)$ is shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13943819/assets/95ad3043259402375e7b5822aef88d77027222a3372c2b8ab042d1b54e08666f.png)

 

So, the correct answer is "III only."
